name: TSIOLKOVSKIY — farside central peak

meta.citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 38 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 69 x 35 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: The farside's most prominent dark-floored crater. Steep ground off the central peak complex.

blurb: The farside's most striking crater: a bright central peak standing in a dark mare-flooded floor. Steep ground off the peak complex.
